insight.headline: Taxes Recalculated
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated on an unfulfilled order. This change affects the GraphQL Admin API and applies to orders updated through this mutation as of August 31, 2026. The recalculation is based on the new shipping destination.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should be aware of this change when updating orders through the GraphQL Admin API, especially if their apps rely on the orderUpdate mutation. They should test their apps to ensure compatibility with the new tax recalculation behavior. Additionally, developers should review their apps' tax handling logic to accommodate this update. The GraphQL Admin API's orderUpdate mutation now returns updated tax information after a shipping address change.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see more accurate tax calculations for their orders when the shipping address is updated, which can affect their order totals and customer invoices.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy of tax calculations for orders with updated shipping addresses, which is crucial for merchants to comply with tax regulations and provide correct invoices to customers.

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: The Hydrogen developer preview has been updated with new capabilities, including Vue bindings, and there have been patch updates to @shopify/cli-hydrogen and @shopify/mini-oxygen. These updates improve the reliability of local debugger connections and add new features to the Hydrogen toolkit.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Enhancements
themes.detail: New fields have been added to the GraphQL Admin API for cash management activities and drawers in POS, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities. Additionally, updating an order's shipping address now recalculates taxes, and the Customer object in Shopify Functions now includes a createdAt field.

themes.title: Ecosystem Updates
themes.detail: The shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement, and merchants can see partner details on collaborator requests. POS UI extensions can also now print directly to hardware receipt printers using the Printing API.
